workflow: Two independent browser-local lanes, ten coherent fictional cases and genuine watermarked document files. Ephemeral read-only customer preview uses an independent session and leaves the current draft untouched.
countScope: Independent functional assertions; Node parent tests, build/type checks, corpus review and archive/publication checks are counted separately.

retainedComponentEvidence.scope: Unchanged geographic integration, urgent guidance, motion, grouping, layout stability and provider preparation retain v2.3.2/v2.3 evidence. They were not all rerun in this release; representative actual API/workflow/static UI checks were rerun.

limits: Fictional case calendar is fixed at 2026-10-08; completion percentages count actions, not health improvement.
Data is local to each browser. Payment, OTP, clinicians, specimen documents and coordination institutions are synthetic.
Customer preview is read-only and ephemeral; complete demo permits normal role workflow mutations in its separate local store.
Public facility data remains a dated real Geoapify/OpenStreetMap snapshot, with Neshan directions; live gateway is not deployed.
No real-device, exhaustive security, load-test or clinical-validation claim.
publication: Public HTTPS readback is recorded independently in ux-publication.json.
packageValidation: Archive integrity, source rebuild and link/mirror checks are performed separately; see ux-archive-validation.json.
